description: This file declares functions and includes necessary headers related to fuel calculations, such as fuel map initialization, fuel quantity computations, and corrections based on engine parameters for an engine control system.

methods.name: initFuelMap
methods.description: Initializes the fuel map with engine parameters.

methods.name: getBaseFuel
methods.description: Returns total injection time into all cylinders before CLT & IAT corrections.

methods.name: getRunningFuel
methods.description: Returns base fuel adjusted with CLT and IAT corrections.

methods.name: getRealMafFuel
methods.description: Calculates the fuel based on real mass airflow and RPM.

methods.name: getBaseTableFuel
methods.description: Retrieves base table fuel value based on RPM and engine load.

methods.name: getBaroCorrection
methods.description: Calculates correction based on barometric pressure.

methods.name: getNumberOfInjections
methods.description: Returns number of injections based on the injection mode.

methods.name: getInjectionOffset
methods.description: Returns injection timing offset based on RPM.

methods.name: getIatFuelCorrection
methods.description: Calculates correction to fuel based on intake air temperature.

methods.name: getInjectorLag
methods.description: Estimates injector lag based on battery voltage.

methods.name: getCltFuelCorrection
methods.description: Returns fuel correction based on coolant temperature.

methods.name: getFuelCutOffCorrection
methods.description: Calculates correction to cut off fuel under certain conditions.

methods.name: getCltTimingCorrection
methods.description: Returns timing correction based on coolant temperature.

methods.name: getCrankingFuel
methods.description: Calculates cranking fuel in engine control context.

methods.name: getCrankingFuel3
methods.description: Calculates cranking fuel with coolant temperature and revolution counter.

methods.name: getInjectionDuration
methods.description: Returns injection duration based on RPM.

methods.name: getInjectorDutyCycle
methods.description: Returns injector duty cycle based on RPM.

methods.name: getFuelRate
methods.description: Converts injection duration to fuel rate.
